Connects OpenClaw to a GBrain brain: sets up GBrain's own service when needed and adds it as the gbrain MCP server.

## Distribution

- Package: `@openclaw/gbrain`
- Install route: npm or ClawHub: `@openclaw/gbrain`

## Surface

This plugin declares no channels, providers, commands, or contracts.
